tldr: 台股經歷慘烈一週：外資單日賣超約3,025億元創紀錄、八個交易日累計倒貨約6,800億元，台指期夜盤一度下探46,140點。
國家隊進場護盤砸約66億元，外資在台積電法說利多後仍倒貨約2.2萬張。
台積電第三季營收估約1.49兆元、年增約50%且優於財測，AI與先進製程仍是晶片供應鏈主引擎。
財富管理政策加溫：臺灣銀行開辦高資產業務，亞洲資產管理中心政策帶動資產管理規模較推動前增逾10兆元。

items.title_zh: 外資賣超創紀錄 一週劇烈震盪 台指期夜盤下探46,140
items.title_en: Record foreign selling drives a volatile week; overnight futures slide toward 46,140
items.summary_zh: 台股結束慘烈一週，外資單日賣超約3,025億元創下紀錄，並連八個交易日倒貨、累計約6,800億元，期貨淨空單升逾9.3萬口。大盤在重挫逾1,656點後出現技術性反彈，台指期夜盤則一度下探46,140點，顯示周末前市場風險偏好仍偏保守。資金在AI融資疑慮與高檔評價壓力下持續調節，權值股承壓牽動指數方向，短線須留意外資動向與期貨空單是否進一步累積。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's market closed a punishing week in which foreign investors set a single-day net-sell record of about NT$302.5bn and extended an eight-session selling run totalling roughly NT$680bn, pushing net short futures positions above 93,000 lots. The benchmark whipsawed from a 1,656-point plunge to a technical bounce, while the index-futures overnight session slid toward 46,140, signalling persistent risk-off sentiment heading into the weekend amid AI-funding and valuation worries.

items.title_zh: 外資倒貨台積電2.2萬張 國家隊進場護盤
items.title_en: National team buys as foreign funds dump 22,000 TSMC lots after record earnings
items.summary_zh: 即便台積電公布第三季獲利創高，外資仍倒貨約2.2萬張、連八日賣超約461億元，並調節大型ETF部位。國家隊進場買進約66億元護盤，南亞、台塑、群創等列入護盤名單，投信同步連六日買超，合力支撐指數。此一「外資賣、國家隊與投信接」的格局，凸顯當前台股由國內資金對抗外資調節的拉鋸，後續護盤力道與外資是否轉買，將牽動大盤能否站穩關鍵價位。
items.summary_en: Even after TSMC posted record third-quarter results, foreign investors offloaded about 22,000 of its shares in lots, extending an eighth straight day of net selling worth around NT$46.1bn, while cutting large ETF holdings. Taiwan's national stabilisation team stepped in with roughly NT$6.6bn of buying, with names such as Nan Ya, Formosa Plastics and Innolux among those supported, as domestic investment trusts logged a sixth consecutive day of buying to cushion the index.

items.title_zh: 台積電第三季營收估約1.49兆元 年增約50%優於財測
items.title_en: TSMC's Q3 revenue estimated near NT$1.49tn, up about 50% and above guidance
items.summary_zh: 產業數據顯示，台積電第三季營收約新台幣1.49兆元、年增約50%，超出公司原先以美元計算的財測區間，再度印證AI加速器與先進製程需求仍是晶圓代工供應鏈的主要動能。隨2奈米製程放量、高效能運算（HPC）占營收比重居高，產能、CoWoS先進封裝與設備訂單持續成為供應鏈規劃核心，有利台廠晶圓代工、封測與AI伺服器零組件業者的接單與獲利延續至2027年，惟須留意終端需求與匯率波動的牽動。
items.summary_en: Industry data put TSMC's third-quarter revenue at roughly NT$1.49tn, a year-on-year gain of about 50% that exceeded the company's own US-dollar guidance range, underscoring that AI accelerators and advanced-node demand remain the chip supply chain's main engine. With the 2nm ramp underway and high-performance computing dominating sales, capacity, CoWoS advanced packaging and equipment orders stay central to suppliers' planning, keeping earnings momentum intact for Taiwan's foundry and AI-server component makers into 2027.

items.title_zh: AI需求使記憶體供給吃緊 採購從現貨轉長約
items.title_en: AI demand keeps memory tight as buyers shift from spot to long-term contracts
items.summary_zh: 分析指出，AI帶動的需求讓DRAM供給持續吃緊，客戶採購模式由現貨轉向長期合約，部分甚至預付資金以鎖定產能，此一結構性轉變有利記憶體業者的價格主導力。惟近期記憶體族群在違約交割與風險意識升溫下出現獲利了結賣壓，使類股波動加大。整體而言，AI上行循環延續至第四季的基本面未變，但資金面與籌碼面的雜音升高，投資人須留意漲價題材與實際拉貨動能是否同步。
items.summary_en: Analysts note AI-driven demand is keeping DRAM supply tight, prompting customers to move from spot purchases toward long-term contracts and even prepay to lock in capacity, a structural shift that supports memory makers' pricing power. At the same time, parts of the memory complex saw profit-taking as default-settlement and risk concerns rose, leaving the sector volatile even as the underlying AI up-cycle persists into the fourth quarter.

items.title_zh: 外資賣超破紀錄考驗市場穩定 國家隊進場因應
items.title_en: Record foreign outflow tests market stability as the national team intervenes
items.summary_zh: 本週外資單日賣超約3,025億元創紀錄，為連八日調節的一環，考驗國內市場穩定度，並促使國家隊進場。賣壓集中於權值股與大型ETF，使市場關注散戶融資部位與違約交割風險，主管機關與政府基金則逆勢承接。此一事件凸顯在全球AI評價承壓期間，國內法人買盤被用以抵銷外資去風險化的操作。後續須留意資金面是否惡化、以及護盤資源的持續性，對金融市場信心與相關族群評價構成影響。
items.summary_en: The week's single-day foreign net-sell record of about NT$302.5bn, part of an eight-session exodus, tested local market stability and prompted the national stabilisation team to step in. The scale of the selling, concentrated in index heavyweights and large ETFs, raised scrutiny of margin positions and default-settlement risk among retail investors, while regulators and state-linked funds leaned against the move. The episode highlights how domestic institutional buying is being used to offset foreign de-risking during bouts of global AI-valuation stress.

items.title_zh: 亞洲資產管理中心政策帶動 資產管理規模增逾10兆元
items.title_en: Asian asset-management hub push lifts managed assets by over NT$10tn
items.summary_zh: 在政府推動的亞洲資產管理中心政策下，由專責推動辦公室協調，國內金融業資產管理規模較政策推動前增加逾10兆元，官方並稱已見初步成效。此政策涵蓋基金、信託與高資產顧問業務，被定位為銀行與資產管理業者的多年期成長動能，擴大財富管理與法人服務的可及市場，並加劇業者爭取零售與家族辦公室客群的競爭。後續子法鬆綁與業者實際承作進度，將決定政策紅利能否持續轉化為獲利動能。
items.summary_en: Under the government's Asian asset-management hub policy, coordinated by the dedicated promotion office, domestic financial institutions' managed assets have grown by more than NT$10tn versus the policy's starting point, with officials citing tangible early results. The programme spans fund, trust and high-net-worth advisory businesses and is positioned as a multi-year growth driver for banks and asset managers, broadening the addressable market for wealth and institutional services and intensifying competition for both retail and family-office clients.

items.title_zh: 臺灣銀行開辦高資產業務 推黃金現貨指定保管
items.title_en: Bank of Taiwan launches high-net-worth services with gold-custody offering
items.summary_zh: 公股的臺灣銀行正式開辦高資產財富管理業務，並率先提供「黃金現貨指定保管」服務，整合投資、信託、保險等業務，結合臺銀人壽與臺銀證券資源組成專責團隊。此舉為台灣高端顧問與傳承規劃市場再添一家具規模的公股競爭者，與民營銀行、私人銀行爭取高資產客群，亦呼應深化境內資產管理服務的政策方向。對財富管理業務而言，公股行庫以保管與穩健訴求切入，有助擴大客群，但差異化服務與收費模式將是決勝關鍵。
items.summary_en: State-owned Bank of Taiwan has formally opened its high-net-worth wealth-management business, becoming the first to offer designated physical-gold custody, and has assembled a dedicated team integrating investment, trust and insurance capabilities alongside resources from BankTaiwan Life and BankTaiwan Securities. The move expands Taiwan's high-end advisory and succession-planning landscape, adding a large public-sector competitor to private banks courting wealthy clients and reinforcing the broader policy push to deepen onshore asset-management services.

items.title_zh: 高資產財富估年均成長約10% 中信報告揭家辦認知落差
items.title_en: High-net-worth wealth projected to grow about 10% a year, says CTBC report
items.summary_zh: 一份針對台灣超高資產客群的財富洞察報告估計，該客群個人財富總額在2025至2029年間將以年均約10%成長，高於整體經濟增速。報告並發現，逾八成高資產客戶聽過家族辦公室，但僅約17%深入了解其運作與功能，顯示存在明顯的教育與顧問缺口。對銀行與私人銀行業務而言，數據同時凸顯市場規模與建立信任、傳承及家辦專業的必要性，誰能補上認知落差、提供整合式解方，將在高資產財管競局中取得先機。
items.summary_en: A wealth-insight report on Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth segment estimates the group's total personal wealth will grow at roughly 10% a year across 2025–2029, outpacing broad economic growth. The study also finds that while more than 80% of wealthy clients have heard of family offices, only about 17% understand how they operate, pointing to a sizeable education and advisory gap. For banks and private-banking units, the data underscore both the scale of the opportunity and the need to build trust, succession and family-office expertise.
